Whether the current world allows avatar scaling.
Toggles AFK mode on and off. Only has an effect when changing from 0 to 1.
Spins you instantly to the left. Only has an effect in VR.
Spins you instantly to the right. Only has an effect in VR.
Drops the item in your left hand.
Drops the item in your right hand.
Grabs the item near your left hand.
Grabs the item near your right hand.
Moves you right for values above 0, and left for values below 0.
Jumps when the input changes to 1. Only has an effect when changing from 0 to 1.
Looks to the right for values above 0, and to the left for values below 0.
Looks to the left while the input equals 1..
Looks to the right while the input equals 1..
Looks up for values above 0, and down for values below 0.
Moves you backward while the input equals 1..
Moves you forward while the input equals 1..

Moves you Right while the input equals 1..
Turns on Panic mode for your safety.
Toggles the state of the QuickMenu attached to your left hand. Only has an effect when changing from 0 to 1.
Toggles the state of the QuickMenu attached to your left hand. Only has an effect when changing from 0 to 1.
Applies run speed while the input equals 1.
Displays some debugging visualizations for VRC_UiShapes (interactable UIs). Only accessible to the world creator unless they have turned on 'World Debugging' via the website.
Displays information about loaded asset bundles. It is mostly irrelevant to world development.
Displays the current build of VRChat that you are using, along with your FPS.
Displays your output log.
Displays various stats about other users. VR?: Whether or not the user is in VR. More info at https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/world-debug-views#debug-menu-4
Displays some graphs related to networking. They are unlabeled and mostly not useful.
Displays all the networked objects in your world, along with various stats. Only accessible to the world creator unless they have turned on 'World Debugging' via the website.
Overlays visual representations of every PhysBone and Contact in the world near the local player. Only accessible to the world creator unless they have turned on 'World Debugging' via the website.

Overlays a panel on top of every synced object in the world. Each panel displays various stats about that specific object. Only accessible to the world creator unless they have turned on 'World Debugging' via the website. More info at https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/world-debug-views#debug-menu-8
Displays debug stats for every player in the instance at their feet. Only accessible to the world creator unless they have turned on 'World Debugging' via the website.
Spins the held item Clockwise for values above 0, and Counter-Clockwise for values below 0.
Spins the held item Left for values above 0, and Right for values below 0.
Spins the held item Up for values above 0, and Down for values below 0.
Toggles between Sitting and Standing modes. Only has an effect in VR.
Uses the item in your left hand.
Uses the item in your right hand.
Moves you forward for values above 0, and backwards for values below 0.
In 'Toggle Mic' mode, Toggles your Mic when changing the input from 0 to 1. In Push-To-Talk Mode, 0 = Muted and 1 = Unmuted.
